title: Slightly Improved Gui
description: Enhances the minecraft gui with slight color palette changes and a lot tweaks.
body:
This resource pack is my personal gui pack that I have been using for a while
> See [gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/slightly-improved-gui/gallery) for what is changed and how does it look. 

# 
This resource pack requires EMF mod for armorstand base texture to work on gui other then that the pack is mod free.
